title: Momentic joins Microsoft for Startups Pegasus
summary: We've joined Microsoft for Startups Pegasus. Azure customers can now buy Momentic on the Microsoft Marketplace and count it toward their Azure commitment.
body_markdown:
Momentic now runs on Azure. Our agents call Claude and OpenAI models through Microsoft Foundry, and Microsoft wrote up how we built it:[From Plain English to Passing Tests: Momentic on Microsoft Foundry with Claude](https://www.microsoft.com/en/customers/story/27404-momentic-foundry-models) .


What changes if your company runs on Azure:


- You can buy Momentic on the[Microsoft Marketplace](https://marketplace.microsoft.com/en-us/product/momentic-ai.momentic_ai_saas) .
- What you spend on Momentic there counts toward your Microsoft Azure Consumption Commitment (MACC).
- Your Microsoft account team can bring Momentic into your account.


> “We're excited to welcome Momentic to the Microsoft for Startups Pegasus Program. This initiative gives select startups access to Azure's cutting-edge AI models, enterprise-grade security and privacy, and unique go-to-market support to accelerate growth. Through Pegasus, startups can build fast, scale smart, and sell more by tapping into the full power of Azure and the Microsoft ecosystem.”


Tom Davis


General Manager, Microsoft for Startups


> “AI is writing more of the code teams ship, and someone still has to check that it works. That's what Mo does. Pegasus puts Momentic in front of the enterprises building on Azure, and lets them buy it through the Marketplace they already use.”


Wei-Wei Wu


Co-founder and CEO, Momentic


Questions about buying Momentic through Azure?[Talk to our team](https://momentic.ai/sales) .
